{{Quote|I sense trouble&hellip; gundarks are approaching!|Qui-Gon Jinn alerts the Wookiees to the gundark attack|audio=TU2-WNARN-L56.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|command center]] built by members of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was '''attacked''' by four predatory [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]] sometime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. The [[command center]] was one of the early Wookiee bases on Alaris Prime during their [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization]] effort there, and prior to the attack, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] had been instructing five Wookiee workers on techniques for gathering various resources. After a short period of [[Time/Legends|time]], the gundarks found and attacked the command center, but the workers retreated into the building and fired at the creatures with its [[Autoturret/Legends|turret]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] all of them. The Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] later launched an [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|attack]] on the [[Unidentified gundark nest|gundarks' nest]] in order to exterminate them.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|When workers are in trouble, they can run to the command center for shelter. They can even shoot at invaders from the command center.|Qui-Gon Jinn, teaching the Wookiees how to use the command center's turrets|audio=WorkerInstruct.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Sometime between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]],<ref name="NEC & GB">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], and the ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' databank states that the debate took place over a twenty-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] period.</ref> the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovered]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]]. These [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], represented by the [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|petitioned]] the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to give their species colonization rights to Alaris Prime. After twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of debate, the Wookiees finally won the rights and headed for the moon<ref name="GB" /> sometime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> with Attichitcuk being named leader of the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] as a reward for his victory in the Senate. Attichitcuk's [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], was also selected as one of the colonists' leaders, and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was also sent to Alaris Prime by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to aid the Wookiees.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Unidentified_Wookiee_command_center.png|thumb|left|250px|The site of the attack, a Wookiee command center]]
Soon after they landed on the moon and established their first [[Attichitcuk's camp|base]], the Wookiees were [[Attack on Attichitcuk's camp|attacked]] by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predatory species. The Wookiees defeated the creatures and began to expand their colony, with the next base established being a lone [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|command center]]. [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 1|Three]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 2|Wookiee]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 3|workers]] were stationed at the base, where Jinn taught them how to gather [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for the colony by harvesting [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] from [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]]. Later, a [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 4|fourth]] worker arrived at the base, whom Jinn instructed on how to catch [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from the nearby [[Water/Legends|river]]. Another [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 5|worker]] arrived at the [[command center]] after a sufficient amount of food had been gathered, and Jinn afterward had the Wookiees practice a drill in which they retreated into the command center to use its [[Autoturret/Legends|turret]] system to defend themselves in case of attack from the gundarks or any other enemy. Following the drill, the workers began gathering [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] from the nearby [[Tree/Legends|trees]], which could be processed into [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] and used for building. Chewbacca later arrived to assist at the base, and simultaneously four gundarks approached the command center.<ref name="GB" />

==The attack==
Using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Jinn sensed the approaching gundarks and alerted the five workers. They immediately ceased gathering resources, retreated into the command center as they had practiced in the drill earlier, and fired at the gundarks with the turret. Chewbacca also used his [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] to attack the creatures, and all of them were [[Death/Legends|killed]] without any serious damage done to the command center or the Wookiees.<ref name="GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|That was quick thinking.|Qui-Gon Jinn, after the attack|audio=Thinking.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Gundark_nest.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The Wookiees went to attack the gundarks but found themselves fighting battle droids instead.]]
The workers exited the command center and returned to gathering resources for the colony. Chewbacca scouted the area around the base further and discovered supplies of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], a form of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]], a [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] that could be processed into [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], which was useful for strengthening buildings. The workers gathered enough of these resources to sustain the base. Following the attack on the command center, Jinn decided it was [[Time/Legends|time]] to take action against the gundarks, and he had the Wookiees train a small [[Army/Legends|army]] to [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|wipe out]] the creatures at their [[Unidentified gundark nest|nest]]. When they launched the attack, the Wookiees encountered a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] belonging to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a corporation that had illegally started its own colonization on Alaris Prime. This led to several battles between the two groups, which ultimately saw the Trade Federation driven off the moon in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Select your command center and sound the alarm to bring the workers inside!|Qui-Gon Jinn instructs the player to garrison the workers|audio=ConcernedJinn.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The attack on the Wookiee command center was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The attack is featured in the second level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Gathering Resources," in which the player uses the Wookiees and has to fight off the gundarks. The player may lose the level when the gundarks attack if the command center is destroyed.<ref name="GB" />
